sections.title: Signup & Email Verification (Parent)
items: Register a new parent account — confirm "check your email" screen appears
Try adding a kid profile BEFORE verifying email — should be blocked with a friendly message
Click the verification link — confirm success page
Add a kid profile AFTER verifying — should work
Log out and log back in

sections.title: What's New Modal (Beta Tester)
items: Log in as a beta tester — What's New popup appears with latest updates
Click "Got it!" — modal closes, doesn't reappear this session
Log out, log back in — modal does NOT reappear (already seen)
(After a new What's New entry is published) Log in — modal reappears with only the new items

sections.title: Articles — Reading
items: Open homepage — today's edition loads with hero images (no broken images, no "undefined" text)
Open an article — body, kid take, family discussion questions all render
Check glossary — terms have definitions (no "undefined")
Check sources — show publisher names and links (no "undefined")
Check "Try it yourself" cards and "Watch the story" embeds render
Save to bookshelf — confirm it saves, check bookshelf page shows it

sections.title: Articles — Listen / TTS
items: Click Listen — voice picker shows (Lessac, Amy, Ryan, Danny)
Play with each voice — audio plays, no errors
Switch voice mid-article — new voice is used
Reload page — voice choice is remembered
(If no pre-made audio) Confirm on-demand narration kicks in

sections.title: Reactions & Comments
items: Thumbs up an article — count goes up, persists after reload
Thumbs down — count goes up
Remove your reaction — count goes back down
Post a comment as a kid — stays hidden, says "pending parent approval"
Post a comment as a grown-up — appears immediately
Parent approves kid's comment — becomes visible publicly as "a young reader" (no real name)
Try posting with a swear word — should be blocked
Post 11 comments quickly — 11th should be rate-limited

sections.title: Daily Quiz
items: Open today's quiz — 5 questions load
Answer all 5, submit — score shows, XP awarded (5 XP each)
Try taking it again same day — blocked (1 attempt/day)
Check teacher leaderboard — your score appears

sections.title: Ask the Correspondent
items: Ask a question on an article — appears as pending
Ask 6 questions — 6th blocked (5 open limit)
(Admin) Answer a question — answer appears publicly
Public Q&A shows asker as tier/level, NOT kid's name

sections.title: Assignments (Teacher → Kid)
items: Teacher: create an assignment for a class
Teacher: edit the assignment (PATCH) — changes save
Kid: open assignments page — sees the assignment
Kid: complete it (read the article) — progress tracks
Teacher: check class progress — sees kid's completion

sections.title: Classrooms & Discussions
items: Teacher: create a class, add kids
Post an announcement — kids/parents see it
Start a discussion — post as teacher
Reply as an enrolled kid — works (this was the Oct 6 bugfix)
Reply as a parent on behalf of kid — works

sections.title: Gamification & Leaderboard
items: Kid dashboard shows XP, level, badges
Earn XP (quiz, reading) — total updates
Leaderboard page — shows real rankings with "a young reader" (no real names)
Reading goals — set a goal, progress tracks
Quiet hours — set them, verify they save

sections.title: Family Feed, Cheers & Friends
items: Send a cheer to a family member — they get a notification
Family feed shows cheers and activity
Send a friend request — other user sees it
Accept friend request — both see each other as friends
Decline a friend request — works, no error
Delete/retract a cheer — disappears

sections.title: Family Chat
items: Open a chat space — messages load
Send a message — appears for other members
Report a message — goes to moderation queue
Delete your own message — disappears

sections.title: Read Together
items: Start a co-reading session from an article
Track progress — saves correctly
Check reading history — session appears

sections.title: Kid Creations
items: Open gallery — creations display with images, likes
Gallery shows "a young reader" (no kid names)
Like a creation — count updates in place
Submit a creation (title, description, image) — appears as pending
(Admin/Parent) Approve a creation — appears in gallery

sections.title: Weekend Lab & Polls
items: Open Weekend Lab — current poll shows
Vote in the poll — vote counts, results update
(Admin) Close a poll, reopen it — both work

sections.title: Search
items: Search for "space" — results appear, ranked (title matches first)
Search as you type — live results update
Click a result — goes to the article

sections.title: Notifications
items: Bell icon shows unread count
Trigger a notification (get a cheer, have a comment approved) — bell updates
Open notifications — list shows with links
Mark one as read — count drops
Mark all as read — count clears
Subscribe to push notifications — confirm dialog names the browser push service
(If subscribed) Verify edition drop alert arrives

sections.title: Contact & Newsletter
items: Submit the contact form — success message, no error
Subscribe to newsletter — confirmation
Unsubscribe from newsletter — works, no more emails

sections.title: Privacy, Consent & Data
items: Open privacy notice — reads clearly, mentions all features, dated Oct 6 2026
Parent dashboard: find "delete kid data" button
Click it, type kid's name to confirm — data wiped, summary shown
Verify kid's quiz history, comments, XP are gone

sections.title: Parent-Teacher Messaging
items: Parent: open teacher messages, start a thread about your kid
Teacher: see the thread, reply
Confirm messages are private (not visible to other parents)

sections.title: Admin Console (Admin role only)
items: Open Review Console — today's drafts appear
Publish a draft — goes live
Reject a draft — removed from queue
Use "edit story" deep link (?editStoryId=) — opens the story editor (Oct 6 fix)
Check social drafts queue — create a manual draft
Check analytics — numbers load

sections.title: Mobile / Responsive (iPhone + Android)
items: All of the above on a phone-sized screen — no overlapping text, buttons tappable
Article toolbar doesn't float or cover content
Listen/voice picker works on mobile Safari and Chrome

sections.title: No Regressions
items: No "undefined" or "null" text visible on any page
No broken images (all show Nexus Glow art or real photos)
No JavaScript console errors on homepage, article page, dashboard
All nav links work — no 404s, no dead ends
